_comment: DASHING_FLASHFOOT_FIRST_DAMAGE was set by nothing. 'The first time this deals damage to a hero' is a once-per-turn gate on the trigger, and it belongs on the DAMAGE event, not on ON_ATTACK -- an attack that is fully blocked deals no damage and must not create the token. The Quickstrike clause grants both the +1{p} and the arcane trigger only while this has go again, so both are gated on that, not just the first.
